_comment.purpose: Supersedes lead-rescue-notification-sink.json for the one thing that receiver could not do: be asked afterwards whether a specific operation arrived. The sink echoed a receipt and persisted nothing of its own, so WebhookSideEffectExecutor.attemptVerify had no channel to query and refused — honestly, and uselessly. This records every delivery in a data table keyed by idempotency key, which lead-rescue-delivery-lookup.json then reads.
_comment.orderingIsTheWholePoint: Record Delivery runs BEFORE Return Receipt, and that ordering is load-bearing rather than stylistic. It means any delivery that received a 2xx is in the table, so a later lookup finding a row is evidence the operation genuinely arrived. Responding first and recording afterwards would produce confirmations for rows that might never have been written.
_comment.whatItStillCannotProve: That a delivery ABSENT from this table never arrived. A request can be accepted at the socket and die before the insert — which is precisely the failure that produces the OUTCOME_UNKNOWN being investigated. attemptVerify therefore treats a missing row as STILL_UNKNOWN and never as CONFIRMED_NOT_EXECUTED, and no assertion this workflow could add would change that, because it cannot observe what it failed to record.
_comment.deliberatelyNot: It contains NO business logic. Classification, authority, policy, and idempotency decisions all live in the application. A transport seam that starts making decisions stops being a seam.
_comment.blastRadius: It forwards nothing. No email, SMS, chat, or onward webhook leaves this workflow, so nothing on this path can reach a customer however the application is configured.
_comment.provenance: AUTHORED IN THIS REPOSITORY AND NEVER DEPLOYED. Unlike lead-rescue-notification-sink.json, this JSON was not read back from a running instance — no n8n instance has imported it, no execution has run it, and the data table it names does not exist anywhere. It is a definition, not evidence. Treat every claim above as unverified until an instance runs it and an artifact is retained under n8n/evidence/.
